s2.desc: a dim bedroom with a big padded bed and a small bedside lamp

beats.text: Pax and Polly step to a stop side by side, Polly holding a phone in one flipper
Pax gives Polly a worried look and holds out a flipper while she shuffles a little away, holding her phone
Polly holds her phone in front of her chest with both flippers and looks at it while Pax watches
Polly turns and holds her phone up beside her face, smiling with her eyes closed
Pax leans in toward Polly with his eyes squeezed shut and a flipper raised while she keeps the phone up
Pax hides his face behind a flipper while Polly lowers the phone and stares at it with a flat look

spans.notes: plain ground (RGB ~212,228,236), so ECC has no texture. Camera judged locked by the characters: Pax's silhouette and shadow stay at the same box (y 414-666 at 540x960) from f8 to f72, Polly's from f24; the small shifts f0-24 differ between the two (they finish a step), so they are character motion, not the camera. Phone has two lenses and no tuft: not the iFin. No overlay.
phone-screen insert: a photo of Pax with sparkles on the screen (also lead_copy), photo-app UI, only Polly's flippers at the bottom edge.

beats.text: Polly stands holding a phone up beside her and glances sideways with a blank look
Polly narrows her eyes into a flat, unimpressed frown, still holding the phone beside her

spans.notes: plain ground; Polly's box is fixed (x 130-383, y 355-681) from f112 to f128 and her feet and shadow never move: camera locked. No overlay.

spans.view: with a table in front of them holding a plate of salmon and a plate of sushi rolls

beats.text: Pax stuffs pieces of salmon into his beak from a plate while Polly sits beside him holding a phone
Pax looks up wide-eyed with his cheeks full, holding up a piece of salmon, while Polly glances at him
Pax goes back to eating from the plate while Polly looks down at her phone
Polly holds her phone up and points it at Pax while he keeps gobbling the salmon with his eyes closed
Polly lowers the phone and looks at its screen while Pax keeps eating

spans.notes: camera locked f129-204: pixel diff of the table-front band (y 0.70-0.80) is 0.00 vs f129 on every frame; compare 129/204 table edge and sushi plate black. Both leads seated behind the table, upper bodies in view. No overlay.
phone-screen insert: a photo of Pax holding up a plate of salmon with sparkles (also lead_copy), photo-app UI, only Polly's flippers at the bottom edge.

spans.view: with a table in front of her holding a plate of sushi rolls

beats.text: Polly hunches over her phone at the table and squints at it with a frown
Polly lifts her head and stares ahead wide-eyed with her beak slightly open, the phone still in her flipper

spans.notes: 22 frames. Camera locked: compare 235/256 table edge and sushi plate edges black; the band diffs change only where Polly moves and are 0.00 frame to frame from f246. No overlay.

spans.view: with a cream blanket pulled up over the bed

beats.text: Polly sits up in bed looking at her phone while Pax sleeps beside her with his beak open
Polly narrows her eyes and glances sideways at the sleeping Pax, holding her phone
Polly lifts her phone and points it at Pax with a sly frown
Polly aims the phone at Pax and a beam of light from it falls across his sleeping face
Polly brings the phone back to her chest and peers at it while Pax sleeps on

spans.notes: steady night lighting (dimmed palette), kept with time night per the curator ruling; current flat style, not OLD_DESIGN. Camera locked: compare 257/290 and 257/335 bed and lamp edges black; ECC on the bed-front band scale ~0.999, <1 px. The phone's light beam on Pax f316-324 is local, not a whole-picture effect. No overlay.
phone-screen insert: an edited magazine-cover picture of the sleeping Pax with title text (also lead_copy), Polly's flippers at the bottom edge.

spans.view: with a cream blanket pulled up over the bed

beats.text: Polly holds her phone up close and stares at it with a small frown while Pax sleeps beside her
Polly raises the phone beside her face and smiles with her eyes closed as its flash lights up her face
Polly holds the pose, smiling with her eyes closed, while Pax sleeps beside her

spans.notes: same night bedroom set-up as f257-335. Camera locked: ECC on the bed-front band vs f372 scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000; compare 372/407 bed edges black. The selfie flash f391-395 whitens only Polly's face. No overlay.
phone-screen insert: Polly's selfie on the screen (also lead_copy), Polly's flippers at the bottom edge.
